title: Curated span-based sampling and synthetic augmentation for per-domain calibration packs
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: produce reproducible, domain-specific calibration packs that better represent production prompt distributions for FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. Deliver a sampling protocol and augmentation recipe that reduces calibration-induced accuracy regressions while keeping pack sizes practical for CI and on-device calibration workflows.
context: We currently use coarse stratified sampling for calibration packs that often under-represents long-tail spans (e.g., multi-entity prompts, long instructions) that matter for downstream task accuracy. FP8/INT8 profiles are sensitive to activation outliers and distribution tails; if calibration sets miss these cases, we observe layer-wise range mismatch and downstream task degradation. This ticket targets per-domain packs with span-aware selection and light synthetic augmentation to improve distributional coverage without exponentially increasing pack size.
proposed_solution:
1) Span extraction: parse production prompts and identify high-information spans (entities, function calls, delimiters, list items, quoted blocks). Each prompt is split into spans; scoring combines rarity, entropy (language model surprisal), and structural role.
2) Sampling policy: reservoir sampling across time with two stratification axes: domain-intent and span-score buckets (high/medium/low). For domains with >1M daily events, cap per-day selection and enforce diversity by intent cluster.
3) Upweighting: increase sampling weight for low-frequency intents and long-token prompts using an exponential length multiplier.
4) Synthetic augmentation: for a fraction of examples (15-25%), generate paraphrases using the controlled paraphrase model (conservative temperature) and validate semantic similarity via embedding cosine >= 0.85. Also create token-level truncation/expansion variants to exercise KV-cache and attention behavior.
5) Privacy: run PII scrubber before pack inclusion. Keep provenance metadata only in internal CI artifacts, not embedded in packs used for third-party calibration.
sampling_protocol:
- Pack sizing: target 2k examples for small domains, 5k for medium domains, 10k for large domains.
- Per-domain quota: compute domain volume percentile and assign pack size by percentile bracket.
- Per-intent floor: ensure at least 20 examples per intent when possible; use language-model clustering to infer intents for unlabeled traffic.
- Span scoring: score = 0.6*rareness + 0.3*surprisal + 0.1*structural_importance.
- Reservoir with recency: weight recent events with a decay factor alpha=0.15 to capture drift while not discarding historical edge cases.
- Synthetic augment cap: at most 25% of final pack; paraphrase temperature 0.7; max 2 paraphrases per seed example.
- Determinism: sampling pipeline accepts a seed and outputs stable packs for a given window + seed.
validation_plan:
1) Offline metrics: run quantized (FP8 and INT8) inference on calibration pack and measure task metrics (accuracy, F1, EM) and logit-distance distributions vs baseline FP16. 2) Layer diagnostics: per-layer max/min activation histograms, quantization clipping ratio, and KL divergence between FP16 and quantized activation distributions. 3) Accept thresholds: task-metric delta <= 0.8% absolute for critical tasks; clipping ratio < 0.5% for all layers; median embedding cosine >= 0.995. 4) A/B shadow: deploy quantized model in shadow for 72h on production traffic (no user-facing). Compare online metrics and error rates. 5) Regression detection: run eval suite of 500 curated prompts across safety and instruction-following; fail if any high-severity safety regression or >1% drop in instruction score.
6) Fallback policy: if thresholds breached, revert to fp16 or INT8 profile with higher calibration budget and trigger per-layer recalibration.
acceptance_criteria:
- Per-domain packs generated for three pilot domains (chat-assist, code-completion, ecom-search) with final sizes matching project targets.
- FP8 and INT8 quantized models show <=0.8% absolute drop on domain task metrics in offline evaluation and pass safety regressions.
- Sampling pipeline produces deterministic packs given fixed seed and window.
- All calibration packs pass automated PII scrub and privacy checks.
- Documentation and a reproducible notebook for pack generation and validation are checked in.
- Rollout playbook written and reviewed by Reliability and ML infra teams.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (pilot): generate packs for three domains and run offline evals and shadow tests (2 weeks). Phase 2 (scale): integrate pack generation into weekly CI, add per-domain dashboards in Console, and automate alerting on calibration drift. Phase 3 (GA): enable calibration-driven profile selection in Optimize (opt-in) and offer packs as downloadable artifacts for Dedicated/Private customers.
Safety gates: manual signoff after shadow period; automated rollback if online error delta exceeds 0.5%.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: synthetic paraphrases introduce label drift. Mitigation: semantic-similarity threshold and manual spot checks; limit synthetic fraction.
- Risk: PII leakage from logs. Mitigation: upstream PII scrubber, audits, and sampling only on opt-in telemetry for sensitive customers.
- Risk: overfitting calibration packs to non-representative traffic. Mitigation: include multiple windows, reservoir sampling, and holdout sets from separate weeks.
